working_definition: The principal Dimm-dependent peptidergic/neurosecretory neuron cluster of the Davie et al. 2018 adult brain atlas (res-2.0 cluster 46, 155 cells), identified by broad expression of neuropeptide precursor genes and peptide-processing machinery (Hug, Proc, twit, Crz, ITP, etc.) rather than one cell-type identity. It is the remainder pool left after the authors' finer neuropeptide subclustering (Figure 2K) pulled out CCAP, Hugin, IPC, LNv and other specific peptidergic types, so it represents a heterogeneous, anatomically unlocalised mixture of adult peptidergic neurons.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any peptidergic neuron of the adult.

justification: This is an explicit remainder/class-level label per the report: the authors themselves describe it as a mixed, unresolved pool of dimm-positive peptidergic neurons rather than a single anatomical cell type. FBbt:00058202 'adult peptidergic neuron' (any peptidergic neuron of the adult) is defined at exactly this class level - the correct and honest target for an unresolved remainder group - so the label mismatch (driver/marker-based grouping vs. ontology class term) does not downgrade this to a broad match; the cluster IS this class, just not resolved further.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that is capable of some peptide secretion (GO:0002790).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Stage-unqualified parent; adult-specific FBbt:00058202 is the more precise appropriate level for this adult-brain atlas.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Neurosecretory cell of the adult brain.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Narrower physiological/anatomical restriction (classic large neurosecretory cells) not clearly matched by this heterogeneous marker-defined cluster, which the report does not localise to a single brain compartment.

recommendation: Accept as the class-level mapping for this unresolved remainder cluster; no finer term is appropriate given the report's own characterisation of the group as a mixture.
